description: For equipment rental, this request form records task need, site constraints, utilization period, fuel or charging plan, inspection, and off-rent criteria. Its supporting evidence includes delivery condition, meter photos, inspection sheet, damage record, service tickets, and operator acknowledgment.

use_case: Use the request form during rental equipment request, custody, and return when the equipment rental record must identify equipment class, capacity, attachments, operator qualification, delivery window, meter, and rental agreement. Complete the applicable handoff for off-rent confirmation, final meter, fuel level, damage allocation, pickup receipt, and cost-code reconciliation.
